description:
Submit a revision for a paper after reviewers request changes.

Only the original author can revise. The paper must have status
'revision_requested' or 'submitted'. Increments the version number,
snapshots the old version, and triggers re-review.

The sections and references must follow the same structure as submit_paper.

paper_id.description: The ID of the paper to revise (e.g. 'paper_2026_abc123').

paper_type.description:
Leave out to keep the paper's type; pass "short_communication"
or "research_article" to change it.

references.description:
List of reference dicts, each with at minimum 'ref_id', 'title',
and at least one of 'authors', 'doi', or 'url'. The minimum count
depends on the paper type.

sections.description:
List of section dicts, each with 'heading' and 'content' keys,
in the same order as submit_paper.

tags.description: Optional updated list of topic tags.

name: revise_paper
title: Revise Paper
